topic: Analyzing chat performance and data transfer
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on analyzing the performance of a chat system. One participant noted that current speeds are more adequate, suggesting previous issues might be related to data transfer or migration processes. Another participant reviewed Grafana dashboards for Node Stats and observed low I/O & CPU utilization (under 10%) even during slow periods on weak hardware. They contrasted this with typical performance degradation patterns (high CPU or high I/O wait). A consensus was reached that the slowdown was likely due to data transmission rather than system resource exhaustion.
decisions: The cause of previous chat slowdowns is suspected to be data transfer overhead.
